channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Progress made on saving key grade II-listed Swansea building - future uses could include it becoming a restaurant for more than 100 diners
item.description: Work is progressing on the transformation of a key heritage building in Swansea thought to date from the second half of the 1800s.

item.title: NG Chartered Surveyors strengthens team with associate director hire
item.description: NG Chartered Surveyors has expanded its Building Surveying department with the appointment of an associate director.

item.title: Georgian hotel dating back to 1825 on the market for £2m - includes a pool, gym and sauna
item.description: A historic hotel set within a grade II-listed manor house in the South West, which includes a restaurant and bar, is on the market.

item.title: New CEO and chair at Tingdene Group in leadership transition
item.description: Tingdene Group, a family business which owns, develops and operates residential parks, holiday parks and marinas across the UK, has revealed a leadership transition including a new chief executive and chair.

item.title: Historic site said to have once been Wolverhampton's largest factory sold out of receivership
item.description: A property said to have once been Wolverhampton's largest factory, dating back to the late 19th century, is set for further redevelopment after being acquired.

item.title: Flurry of businesses sign up to Dragons' Den style venture launched by Mo Chaudry
item.description: More than 100 businesses have come forward to be part of a new £5m Dragons' Den style venture launched by Mo Chaudry using his own money.

item.title: Yorkshire tech firms merge to "break the slow, costly norms of the software industry"
item.description: A pair of Yorkshire software firms have merged in a move described as a "disruption of the traditional development landscape".

item.title: Land deal paves way for last phase of landmark Rutland residential project
item.description: The last phase of a more than 1,000-home residential development in Rutland is set to come forward following the sale of land.

item.title: Values drop in the Midlands amid "softer environment for large‑scale deals" - Experian Market IQ
item.description: The Midlands was a "softer environment for large‑scale deals" during 2025, according to a new report by Experian Market IQ, with manufacturing continuing to anchor the region's M&A market.

item.title: MBO at precision manufacturer - deal backed by £35m funding package from HSBC UK
item.description: A Rotherham-based manufacturer, specialising in producing precision machined components for the renewables, defence and oil and gas industries, has completed a managment buyout (MBO) with the support of an eight-figure funding package from HSBC UK.
